scripts.clean: rimraf src/generated && rimraf dist && rimraf node_modules
scripts.dev: BACKEND_PORT=${STACK_DEV_FALLBACK_BACKEND:+${NEXT_PUBLIC_HEXCLAVE_PORT_PREFIX:-81}10} && BACKEND_PORT=${BACKEND_PORT:-${NEXT_PUBLIC_HEXCLAVE_PORT_PREFIX:-81}02} && BACKEND_RUNNER="tsx watch --clear-screen=false" && if [ "${STACK_BACKEND_DEV_DISABLE_WATCH:-false}" = "true" ]; then BACKEND_RUNNER="tsx"; fi && concurrently -n "dev,codegen,prisma-studio,email-queue,cron-jobs,bulldozer-studio" -k "STACK_DISABLE_REACT_ASYNC_DEBUG_INFO=${STACK_DISABLE_REACT_ASYNC_DEBUG_INFO:-true} NODE_ENV=development BACKEND_PORT=$BACKEND_PORT dotenv -c development -- $BACKEND_RUNNER ${STACK_BACKEND_DEV_EXTRA_ARGS:-} src/server/server.ts" "pnpm run codegen:watch" "pnpm run prisma-studio" "BACKEND_PORT=$BACKEND_PORT pnpm run run-email-queue" "BACKEND_PORT=$BACKEND_PORT pnpm run run-cron-jobs" "pnpm run run-bulldozer-studio"
scripts.codegen-prisma:watch: echo OOOOOOO && ulimit -n && HEXCLAVE_DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRING="${HEXCLAVE_DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRING:-${STACK_DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRING:-placeholder-database-connection-string}}" pnpm run prisma generate --watch
scripts.codegen-route-info:watch: pnpm run with-env tsx watch --clear-screen=false scripts/generate-route-info.ts
scripts.codegen: pnpm run with-env pnpm run generate-migration-imports && pnpm run with-env bash -c 'if [ "$STACK_ACCELERATE_ENABLED" = "true" ]; then pnpm run prisma generate --no-engine; else pnpm run codegen-prisma; fi' && pnpm run generate-private-sign-up-risk-engine && pnpm run codegen-docs && pnpm run codegen-route-info
scripts.codegen:watch: pnpm run generate-private-sign-up-risk-engine && concurrently -n "prisma,private-risk-engine,docs,route-info,migration-imports" -k "pnpm run codegen-prisma:watch" "pnpm run generate-private-sign-up-risk-engine:watch" "pnpm run codegen-docs:watch" "pnpm run codegen-route-info:watch" "pnpm run generate-migration-imports:watch"
scripts.clickhouse: pnpm run with-env clickhouse-client --host localhost --port ${NEXT_PUBLIC_HEXCLAVE_PORT_PREFIX:-81}37 --user stackframe --password PASSWORD-PLACEHOLDER--9gKyMxJeMx
scripts.psql: pnpm run with-env:dev pnpm run psql-inner
scripts.prisma-studio: pnpm run with-env:dev prisma studio --port ${NEXT_PUBLIC_HEXCLAVE_PORT_PREFIX:-81}06 --browser none
scripts.db:migration-gen: pnpm run with-env:dev tsx scripts/db-migrations.ts generate-migration-file
scripts.db:reset: pnpm run with-env:dev tsx scripts/db-migrations.ts reset
scripts.db:seed: pnpm run with-env:dev tsx scripts/db-migrations.ts seed
scripts.db:init: pnpm run with-env:dev tsx scripts/db-migrations.ts init
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm run with-env:dev tsx scripts/db-migrations.ts migrate
scripts.db:backfill-bulldozer-from-prisma: pnpm run with-env:dev tsx scripts/db-migrations.ts backfill-bulldozer-from-prisma
scripts.db:backfill-internal-free-plans: pnpm run with-env:dev tsx scripts/db-migrations.ts backfill-internal-free-plans
scripts.db:regen-internal-subscriptions-to-lates: pnpm run with-env:dev tsx scripts/db-migrations.ts regen-internal-subscriptions-to-latest
scripts.codegen-docs:watch: pnpm run with-env tsx watch --exclude '**/node_modules/**' --clear-screen=false scripts/generate-openapi-fumadocs.ts
scripts.run-cron-jobs: pnpm run with-env:dev tsx watch --clear-screen=false scripts/run-cron-jobs.ts
